decisions.briefing: Market is neutral today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 flat) with no clear risk-on signal, and available cash ($189.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold anyway. Holding all 7 existing positions unchanged and skipping new buys, consistent with the lesson to avoid forcing trades on low-conviction days.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially flat today, with the NASDAQ down 0.2% and the S&P 500 unchanged, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts in the session.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股主要指數走勢平淡，納斯達克指數下跌0.2%，標普500指數則持平，反映市場缺乏明確的方向性催化劑。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Sometimes the best move is no move — when the market isn't giving clear bullish or bearish signals, and there isn't enough cash to meaningfully add a new position anyway, holding steady preserves capital for a better opportunity rather than forcing a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 有時候最好的操作就是不動——當市場沒有明確的多空訊號，且現金也不足以有意義地建立新倉位時，按兵不動能保留資金，等待更好的進場機會，而不是勉強交易。
